$comment: Issue #33: registration template for a local read-only Lekalo MCP server in an AI Factory extension manifest. This file is a recipe the host operator copies into the extension's own extension.json (or equivalent registration seam); Lekalo never installs, edits, or negotiates with an extension on its own. The command must resolve to a built lekalo binary on the host running the extension runtime; adjust the cwd to the workspace root so the project selector stays relative.
name: lekalo-mcp
description: Read-only Lekalo semantic-layer access: inspect, impact, context, graph, validate, target status, and trace export over the pinned MCP stdio profile.

qualification.note: A registration is qualified only after the host launches the real binary and completes initialize, tools/list, one resources/read, and one tools/call lekalo_context round trip with the captured protocol and contract pins recorded. Schema validity alone is not qualification.
requiredChecks: tools/list exposes exactly the seven read tools with readOnlyHint
resources/read returns application/json with the lekalo/mcp-resource/v0.8.0 envelope
tools/call lekalo_context returns the full capsule in one call with budget facts intact
every refusal carries a registered mcp.* diagnostic or preserved domain diagnostics
